behavior: After an arrow key, Home or End moves the focus to a tab, the whole tab shows in the list, inside the `scroll-padding` of the list and the `scroll-margin` of the tab. The list scrolls by the least distance. The page scrolls only when the tab is out of the view. The scroll of `focus()` differs in each browser: Chromium can leave a cut tab cut, and Firefox can center it. Base UI documents no scroll of the list.
